title: Hustling clubs for sets; Bob Landon in Palm Springs
summary: He went from club to club to sit in and make money, and mentions pianist Bob Landon, who played with him at Nick's and now lives in Palm Springs.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Sometimes you get a job and sometimes you don't. That's why I went out and hustled, you know. I knew I had to get along, so I went out there and did my hustling. I was going around to different clubs at nights, sit in, play
a set, maybe two sets. Make 15, $20.00. Go to the next place, a couple doors down, you know, go right next door and play there. Do you know Bob Landon?
No, I never met Bob Laine. Landon.
You've heard of him, haven't you?
Well, just through you. He lives out in Palm Springs now.
Used to play at Nick's in the Village?
How long has it been since you've seen him?
I haven't seen him now since last year. I saw him last year because I go down to Palm Springs, you know.
You should let him know about your new address.
So he can get in touch with you.
When I get down that way, yeah.
